item.tib: tshe dbang sbyin bsregs me dpung
item.coloph: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thugs kyi gsang bgrugs (sgrub) las/ sbyin bsregs (sreg) ye shes me dpung zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i (mas) dus mtha' yi rnal 'byor bdag la gnang ba/ sbas dad gsang rgya thub pa dad ldan grog (grogs) pos bskur (bskul) ba'i ngor/ dkar chags (chag) yi ger bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs (skyong) srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol//
